title: FedeRICo: Federated Region-Influenced Coupling for Traffic Flow Prediction
summary:
arXiv:2609.20026v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Urban traffic forecasting often relies on information distributed across stakeholders who may be unable to share raw data due to privacy or commercial constraints, motivating federated spatial-temporal approaches. In such federated settings, each client observes traffic over a distinct sensor subgraph with its own spatial topology and temporal dynamics, leading to significant heterogeneity across clients.
